meta.review_notes: Full analysis complete. Key findings: extensive third-party data sharing including advertising partners and data enrichment companies, email sync accesses email content, opt-out available for AI training, data deletion within 30 days available.

app.name: Perplexity - AI Search & Chat
app.description: AI-powered search and chat that delivers direct answers with cited sources.

verdict.one_liner: AI search that automatically collects usage data and shares it with advertising partners and data enrichment companies.
verdict.summary: Perplexity offers AI-powered search but collects extensive usage data including device identifiers, approximate location, and clickstream data. It shares information with advertising partners, business partners, and service providers, and receives data from consumer marketing databases to customize advertising. Email sync grants access to email content and contacts. While it provides strong user rights including account deletion within 30 days and opt-out options for AI training, the broad tracking and third-party sharing warrant caution.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Perplexity shares data with advertising partners and data enrichment companies, automatically collects device identifiers and location data, and accesses email content if synced. Consider using without syncing personal email or creating an account.

red.title: Data shared with advertising partners and data enrichment companies
red.plain_english: Perplexity states that it may disclose your information to Advertising Partners and receives information from consumer marketing databases or data enrichment companies to customize advertising and marketing.

red.title: Email sync accesses content of emails and contacts
red.plain_english: If you sync your email account, Perplexity will have access to your contacts and the content of your email messages and calendar appointments.

red.title: Uses tracking technologies for analytics and advertising
red.plain_english: Perplexity and third parties automatically collect information about your interactions through cookies, pixels, tags, and other tracking technologies.

red.title: Collects unique device identifiers and IP address
red.plain_english: Perplexity automatically collects device information including device type, operating system, unique device identifier, and IP address.

red.title: Data shared during business transactions
red.plain_english: Perplexity will share personal information with prospective buyers, sellers, or new owners during mergers, acquisitions, or other business transactions.

red.title: Data transferred to United States
red.plain_english: Perplexity states that personal information is transferred to, stored in, or accessed from the United States and other countries.

green.title: Email content not used for AI training
green.plain_english: Perplexity explicitly states it does not use or disclose Email Service Information to create, train, improve, or fine-tune AI models.

green.title: Account deletion with 30-day deletion
green.plain_english: You can delete your account and Perplexity aims to delete your personal information from servers within 30 days.

green.title: Can opt out of AI improvement data
green.plain_english: You may opt out of information collection for AI, which prohibits Perplexity from using your search information to improve AI models.

green.title: Recognizes Global Privacy Control signals
green.plain_english: Perplexity recognizes GPC signals from browsers as a valid opt-out request for targeted advertising.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Perplexity's privacy policy does not mention camera or microphone access.
categories.detail: The 38,000+ character privacy policy does not address camera or microphone access for the mobile application.
concerns: Policy silent on camera and microphone access

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Perplexity automatically collects approximate location information. Precise geolocation may be collected from the mobile application with your consent.
categories.detail: Approximate location collected automatically as part of Usage Data. Precise geolocation collected on mobile with consent. Location data shared with advertising partners.
categories.policy_excerpt: Location information, such as approximate location... When you use our mobile application, and consent to the processing of precise geolocation information, such information will be collected.
concerns: Precise geolocation collected with consent on mobile
Location data shared with advertising partners

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: If you sync your email account, Perplexity will have access to your contacts. The policy is silent on direct phonebook access.
categories.detail: Contacts accessed when syncing email accounts (Gmail, etc.). Policy does not explicitly address mobile phonebook/address book access.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you choose to sync these accounts, we will have access to your contacts and information from the email messages and calendar appointments in your email account.
concerns: Policy silent on direct phonebook access

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Perplexity collects content you input, upload, or submit to the Services. Local file storage access is not explicitly addressed.
categories.detail: User-initiated uploads and submissions collected as Service Interaction Information. Policy does not explicitly address local file system access.
categories.policy_excerpt: Your input and output, such as questions, prompts and other content that you input, upload or submit to the Services, and the output that you create... ('Service Interaction Information').
concerns: Policy silent on local storage access

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Perplexity shares data with Company Group, Service Providers, Business Partners, Advertising Partners, Professional Advisors, and may share during business transactions. Also receives data from data enrichment companies.
categories.detail: Extensive sharing: affiliates, vendors, business partners, advertising partners, advisors. Receives data from consumer marketing databases and data enrichment companies for advertising customization.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may disclose your information to third parties subject to this Privacy Policy, including the following categories of third parties: Company Group; Service Providers; Business Partners; Advertising Partners; Professional Advisors; Business Transactions... Information we receive from consumer marketing databases or other data enrichment companies.

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Perplexity collects name, email, phone number, address, username, and password. Receives data from third-party platforms and enrichment companies.
categories.detail: Contact Information and Account Information collected. Data received from Google/Apple sign-in, LinkedIn, and data enrichment companies. Government ID may be collected for job applications.
categories.policy_excerpt: Basic contact details, such as name, address, phone number, and email ('Contact Information'). Account information, such as name, username, email and password ('Account Information')... Information we receive from consumer marketing databases or other data enrichment companies.

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Perplexity uses cookies, pixels, tags, and tracking technologies to collect Usage Data including clickstream data, interactions with marketing emails, and ad impressions. Receives data from enrichment companies for advertising.
categories.detail: Comprehensive tracking: cookies, pixels, tags, device identifiers, clickstream, email interactions, ad impressions. Data from enrichment companies used to customize advertising. GPC signals recognized.
categories.policy_excerpt: We and certain third parties also automatically collect certain information about your interaction with the Services ('Usage Data') through the use of cookies, pixels, tags and other tracking technologies... Information we receive from consumer marketing databases or other data enrichment companies, which we use in our legitimate interests to better customize advertising and marketing.
concerns: Data from enrichment companies for ads

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Children under 13 are not permitted to use the Services. Perplexity does not knowingly collect personal information about children under 13.
categories.detail: Age restriction of 13+ stated. Parental consent required for users above 13 but below age of consent. Commercially reasonable efforts to delete data if collected from underage users.
categories.policy_excerpt: Children under the age of 13 are not permitted to use the Services, and we do not seek or knowingly collect any personal information about children, particularly those under 13 years of age.
concerns: Age restriction stated but app rated 4+

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Perplexity automatically collects IP address, browser type, log data, date and time stamps, clickstream data, and interactions with marketing emails.
categories.detail: IP address, browser info, log data, timestamps, clickstream data, email interactions, and ad impressions collected automatically via tracking technologies.
categories.policy_excerpt: Device information, such as device type, operating system, unique device identifier, and internet protocol (IP) address... Other information regarding your interaction with the Services, such as browser type, log data, date and time stamps, clickstream data, interactions with marketing emails, and ad impressions.

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Perplexity automatically collects device type, operating system, unique device identifier, and IP address. This data is shared with third parties for analytics and advertising.
categories.detail: Device fingerprinting includes device type, OS, unique device identifier, IP address. Used to tailor features, run analytics, and shared with third parties including advertising partners.
categories.policy_excerpt: Device information, such as device type, operating system, unique device identifier, and internet protocol (IP) address... We use Usage Data in our legitimate interests to tailor features and content to you, run analytics and measure and better understand user interaction with the Services, and we may permit third parties to use Usage Data for such purposes.
concerns: Device data shared with third parties

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Perplexity may collect health information if you voluntarily opt in to Perplexity Health. Health, genetic, and biometric information only collected with explicit consent.
categories.detail: Health information collected only on explicit opt-in basis for Perplexity Health. Under CCPA, health, genetic, and biometric information may be collected with consent. Not used for cross-context behavioral advertising.
categories.policy_excerpt: Where available in your location, any health information you choose to provide. We use this information when you voluntarily consent to opt in to Perplexity Health... When you consent to use Perplexity Health and upload data, your health, genetic, and biometric information.
concerns: Health data collected on opt-in basis
Shared with third-party AI models for service provision

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Perplexity collects payment information using a third-party payment processor. Financial information shared with service providers.
categories.detail: Credit/debit card and billing address collected via third-party processor. Financial information shared with Company Group and Service Providers per CCPA disclosure.
categories.policy_excerpt: Payment information, such as credit or debit card information and billing address, which we collect using a third party payment processor... Financial Information – this may include bank account number, credit card number, debit card number, and other financial information.
concerns: Financial info shared with service providers

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: Perplexity provides comprehensive user rights including access, deletion, correction, and portability. Account deletion available with aim to delete data within 30 days. Opt-out available for AI training and targeted advertising.
categories.detail: GDPR/CCPA rights: access, delete, correct, portability, restriction, objection. Account deletion via settings or support. 30-day deletion aim. Opt-out for AI training and targeted advertising. GPC signals recognized.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you delete your account, we aim to delete your personal information from our servers within 30 days... You may opt out of information collection for AI... You may opt-out of online targeted advertising... We recognize Global Privacy Control (GPC) signals.

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Perplexity will use reasonable efforts to notify you of material changes via email or posting on Services. Continued use after updates constitutes acceptance.
categories.detail: Material changes notified via email or posting. Users must stop using Services if they do not agree to updates. Continued use = acceptance. Last updated date shown at top of policy.
categories.policy_excerpt: If we make material changes to the way in which we use or disclose information we collect, we will use reasonable efforts to notify you... If you do not agree to any updates to this Privacy Policy, please do not continue using or accessing the Services.
